conditions: The cited rule is for actual finalization of the object. The controlled hook condition requires a tagged full type and a tag identifying a controlled type.
limitations: The claim specifies the relative position of the whole-object actions. It leaves the internal component-finalization ordering to paragraph 9/3 and the coextension rule to paragraph 9.1/2.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: Under the Ada 2022 Reference Manual's object-finalization rule, when the full type is tagged and the object's tag identifies a controlled type, that type's Finalize routine is invoked. For a composite object, the components are finalized after the applicable object-level actions.
